title: Technical Product Manager learning roadmap
summary: A step-by-step guide to move from zero to a job-ready Technical Product Manager, covering fundamentals, core product skills, portfolio projects, and job readiness. Each phase builds concrete abilities and a showcase of work.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Lay the groundwork in technology basics, business context, and product thinking.

milestones.title: Understand APIs and system basics
milestones.outcome: Can explain how web APIs work and diagram simple system architectures.

tasks.title: Read API fundamentals on MDN
tasks.description: Study the MDN Web Docs pages on HTTP, REST, and JSON to grasp request/response cycles.

tasks.title: Watch freeCodeCamp API tutorial
tasks.description: Follow the freeCodeCamp video on building a simple REST API with Node.js.

tasks.title: Sketch a sample API flow
tasks.description: Create a diagram of a client calling an API endpoint and receiving data.

tasks.title: Write a short API explanation
tasks.description: Draft a one-page summary describing what an API is for a non-technical audience.

milestones.title: Intro to SQL and data literacy
milestones.outcome: Can query a database to retrieve and filter data for product decisions.

tasks.title: Complete SQL basics on Khan Academy
tasks.description: Finish the introductory SQL lessons covering SELECT, WHERE, and ORDER BY.

tasks.title: Run queries in SQLite Browser
tasks.description: Install SQLite Browser and execute sample queries on a provided dataset.

tasks.title: Summarize query results
tasks.description: Write a brief report interpreting the output of a SELECT query for a product team.

tasks.title: Share findings with a peer
tasks.description: Explain your query and results to a friend or colleague to practice communication.

milestones.title: Product management foundations
milestones.outcome: Can articulate product vision, user needs, and basic prioritisation concepts.

tasks.title: Read product discovery guide on Mind the Product
tasks.description: Study the article on defining user problems and opportunities.

tasks.title: Create a simple user persona
tasks.description: Develop a one-page persona for a hypothetical API consumer.

tasks.title: Prioritise three feature ideas
tasks.description: Apply the MoSCoW method to rank features for the persona’s needs.

tasks.title: Discuss prioritisation with a mentor
tasks.description: Schedule a short call to get feedback on your ranking rationale.

phases.title: Core skills
phases.summary: Develop the practical product tools needed to design, plan, and communicate technical solutions.

milestones.title: Write Technical specs
milestones.outcome: Can produce clear, actionable technical specifications for engineering teams.

tasks.title: Study a spec template on Atlassian Docs
tasks.description: Review the official Atlassian technical spec example to understand structure.

tasks.title: Draft a spec for a login API
tasks.description: Write a concise spec covering endpoint, request/response, error handling, and security.

tasks.title: Get feedback from an engineer
tasks.description: Share the draft with a developer and incorporate their comments.

tasks.title: Revise spec based on feedback
tasks.description: Update the document to improve clarity and completeness.

milestones.title: Delivery planning and roadmapping
milestones.outcome: Can create realistic delivery timelines and roadmap visuals for platform products.

tasks.title: Read roadmap best practices on ProductPlan blog
tasks.description: Absorb key principles for timeline, themes, and stakeholder alignment.

tasks.title: Map a 6-month roadmap in a spreadsheet
tasks.description: Outline major milestones, dependencies, and release windows for a sample API platform.

tasks.title: Add effort estimates using story points
tasks.description: Assign relative effort values to each roadmap item to aid capacity planning.

tasks.title: Present roadmap to a peer group
tasks.description: Explain your roadmap and receive critique on feasibility and clarity.

milestones.title: Develop developer empathy
milestones.outcome: Can anticipate developer needs, speak their language, and foster collaboration.

tasks.title: Read "The Pragmatic engineer" article on developer experience
tasks.description: Understand common pain points and motivations of software engineers.

tasks.title: Interview a developer for 15 minutes
tasks.description: Ask about their workflow, tooling preferences, and frustrations with APIs.

tasks.title: Summarise interview insights
tasks.description: Create a bullet-point list of key empathy takeaways for product decisions.

tasks.title: Apply insights to a spec revision
tasks.description: Adjust your earlier API spec to address at least two developer concerns you uncovered.

phases.title: Proof of work
phases.summary: Create portfolio pieces that demonstrate your ability to define, plan, and communicate technical products.

milestones.title: API Product specification project
milestones.outcome: A polished API spec ready to show recruiters or clients.

tasks.title: Choose a real-world API idea
tasks.description: Select a useful API (e.g., weather data) to design a spec for.

tasks.title: Research existing APIs
tasks.description: Analyze two public APIs to gather best practices and common fields.

tasks.title: Write full technical spec
tasks.description: Produce a detailed spec covering endpoints, authentication, rate limits, and error codes.

tasks.title: Create a spec summary slide
tasks.description: Design a one-page visual that highlights the spec’s key points.

tasks.title: Publish spec on GitHub
tasks.description: Upload the document and README to a public repo for visibility.

milestones.title: Technical roadmap project
milestones.outcome: A visual roadmap illustrating strategic evolution of a platform product.

tasks.title: Define platform scope
tasks.description: Outline the core services and APIs that make up the platform.

tasks.title: Identify three major enhancements
tasks.description: Select strategic features to evolve over 12 months.

tasks.title: Create a Gantt-style roadmap
tasks.description: Use a free tool like Google Sheets to plot timelines, dependencies, and milestones.

tasks.title: Write rationale for each milestone
tasks.description: Explain why each enhancement matters to users and the business.

tasks.title: Share roadmap on LinkedIn
tasks.description: Post the visual with a brief description to attract attention from hiring managers.

milestones.title: Data-backed feature proposal
milestones.outcome: A concise proposal that uses SQL-derived data to justify a new feature.

tasks.title: Select a product metric to improve
tasks.description: Pick a measurable outcome (e.g., API latency) from a sample dataset.

tasks.title: Query data to establish baseline
tasks.description: Write SQL to calculate current performance and identify gaps.

tasks.title: Draft a feature proposal document
tasks.description: Explain the feature, expected impact, and required resources, citing the data you gathered.

tasks.title: Create a one-page KPI chart
tasks.description: Visualise baseline vs projected improvement using a free chart tool.

tasks.title: Present proposal to a mock panel
tasks.description: Simulate a stakeholder meeting and answer questions about feasibility.

phases.title: Getting ready
phases.summary: Polish advanced competencies, interview readiness, and networking for a Technical Product Manager role.

milestones.title: Advanced API governance
milestones.outcome: Can design policies for versioning, deprecation, and security across APIs.

tasks.title: Read API governance guide from Google Cloud
tasks.description: Study the principles of versioning, lifecycle, and access control.

tasks.title: Create a versioning policy document
tasks.description: Write a concise policy covering major/minor version rules and deprecation notices.

tasks.title: Map policy to a sample API
tasks.description: Apply the policy to the earlier API spec to show practical impact.

tasks.title: Discuss policy with a senior PM
tasks.description: Get feedback on completeness and realism from an experienced product manager.

milestones.title: Interview preparation and storytelling
milestones.outcome: Can confidently discuss experiences, solve case questions, and showcase portfolio work.

tasks.title: Study common TPM interview questions on Glassdoor
tasks.description: Read top-rated questions and recommended answer structures.

tasks.title: Write STAR stories for three projects
tasks.description: Craft Situation-Task-Action-Result narratives for each portfolio piece.

tasks.title: Practice mock interview with a peer
tasks.description: Run a 30-minute interview simulation focusing on technical and prioritisation topics.

tasks.title: Record and review your answers
tasks.description: Listen to the recording, note improvement areas, and refine your delivery.

milestones.title: Networking and job search strategy
milestones.outcome: Has a targeted plan to connect with hiring managers and land interviews.

tasks.title: Identify 10 TPMs on LinkedIn
tasks.description: Search for Technical Product Managers at target companies and note their backgrounds.

tasks.title: Send personalized connection requests
tasks.description: Craft brief messages referencing a shared interest or article.

tasks.title: Join a free TPM community Slack
tasks.description: Participate in discussions, ask questions, and share your portfolio links.

tasks.title: Tailor resume to highlight key skills
tasks.description: Update your CV to feature APIs, SQL, specs, and delivery planning experience.
